newsitem.title: USA: Landmark in talks to close Mama Tish IPO.
newsitem.headline: Landmark in talks to close Mama Tish IPO.

text.p: Landmark International Equities said it was in talks to close the initial public offering of Mama Tish's Italian Specialties Inc.
Mama Tish's 2.3 million unit offering priced at $5 per unit on November 11.
Landmark said it was in talks with Hanifen Inhoff Clearing Corp, which processed the trades, to reduce Mama Tish's customer debits to a level acceptable to Hanifen.

Landmark said that although it is in full compliance with all National Association of Securities Dealers capital rules, Hanifen advised Landmark that it must meet certain "risk standards" set by Hanifen in order to close the offering.
Landmark intends to meet the customer debit risk standards today, in order to successfully close the IPO this afternoon.
Landmark also said it plans to recommence its market making activities as soon as possible.
